title: Ninja Warrior in Ruins
description: A female ninja with long flowing green hair and intricate back tattoos stands dynamically in a destroyed wooden building, viewed from behind. She holds a katana in one hand while white smoke swirls around her lower body and glowing circular energy rings with blades hover in the air nearby.
